description: This file defines a custom exception class UnauthorizedException for the OrangeHRM system. It extends the base Exception class and includes a Response object to encapsulate HTTP response details relevant during authorization failures.

classes.name: UnauthorizedException
classes.description: A custom exception class that includes an HTTP Response object to be used when authorization fails within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the UnauthorizedException with an HTTP Response object and optional message, code, and previous exception.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the associated HTTP Response object.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the HTTP Response object for this exception.
